title: Spring and well protection perimeter
summary: Protects natural water points from runoff, animals, waste, crowd damage, and dirty containers.
content: Spring and well protection perimeter is a practical offline routine for source protection. Mark an inner clean zone where no washing, animals, toilets, trash, fuel, or bathing are allowed. Map uphill runoff, latrines, animal paths, flooded areas, roads, and chemical storage. Use a queue and clean-container rule so dirty vessels are not dipped into the source. Inspect after rain, earthquake, wildfire, crowd use, or animal intrusion. Close or downgrade the source if contamination is suspected.
steps: Close or downgrade the source if contamination is suspected.
